title: Reinforcement Learning with Metacognitive Feedback Elicits Faithful Uncertainty Expression in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.32032v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Metacognition is a critical component of intelligence that describes the ability to monitor and regulate one's own cognitive processes. Yet LLMs exhibit systemic deficiencies in key metacognitive faculties: they hallucinate with high confidence, fail to recognize knowledge boundaries, and misrepresent their internal uncertainty--undermining trustworthiness and reliability. Since monitoring task performance and adapting behavior accordingly are central to metacognition, we posit that models capable of accurately judging their own performance are better positioned to improve it. We operationalize this idea via two novel mechanisms: reinforcement learning with metacognitive feedback (RLMF), a paradigm to refine completion rankings during preference optimization based on the quality of a model's self-judgments of performance, and metacognitive data selection, which uses similar self-judgments to identify high-value training example

translated_title: 基于元认知反馈的强化学习在大语言模型中引出忠实的不确定性表达
translated_abstract: 元认知是智能的关键组成部分，指监控和调节自身认知过程的能力。然而，大语言模型在关键元认知能力方面存在系统性缺陷：它们以高置信度产生幻觉、无法识别知识边界，并错误地表达其内部不确定性——这损害了模型的可信度和可靠性。由于监控任务表现并据此调整行为是元认知的核心，我们提出这样的观点：能够准确判断自身表现的模型更有能力改进其表现。我们通过两种新颖机制将这一想法付诸实践：其一是元认知反馈强化学习（RLMF），这是一种在偏好优化过程中根据模型对自身表现自我判断的质量来优化补全排序的范式；其二是元认知数据选择，它利用类似的自我判断来识别高价值的训练样例。
tldr: 该论文提出元认知反馈强化学习（RLMF）和元认知数据选择两种新机制，利用模型对自身表现的自我判断来改进偏好优化和训练数据筛选，从而使大语言模型能够忠实表达不确定性并准确识别自身知识边界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two novel mechanisms—Reinforcement Learning with Metacognitive Feedback (RLMF) and metacognitive data selection—that leverage models' self-judgments of their own performance to refine preference optimization and identify high-value training examples, eliciting faithful uncertainty expression and reliable knowledge boundary awareness in LLMs.
